userdoc.notice: When two assertions are created that have the same predecessor the protocol needs to decide which of the two is correct         This challenge manager allows the staker who has created the valid assertion to enforce that it will be confirmed, and all         other rival assertions will be rejected. The challenge is all-vs-all in that all assertions with the same         predecessor will vie for succession against each other. Stakers compete by creating edges that reference the assertion they         believe in. These edges are then bisected, reducing the size of the disagreement with each bisection, and narrowing in on the         exact point of disagreement. Eventually, at step size 1, the step can be proved on-chain directly proving that the related assertion         must be invalid.
